summary: Iteration 3 verified the three new FUDORA features (admin sound alerts, customer push notifications, referral rewards). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_referral.py (13 tests) covering /api/me/referral, register-with-referral, personal coupon issuance/ownership/one-time-use and order placement with a personal coupon; full suite run = 82 passed / 2 failed (1 known-open brute-force, 1 NEW real bug: personal coupons leak into public /api/offers). Frontend: verified via Playwright the referral card (profile+offers), copy/share to clipboard, ?ref= prefill, '+ Have a referral code?' reveal, UI signup with referral -> WELCOME reward card, restaurant-admin toggle-alerts (label toggles + persists in localStorage), pending orders gold-highlighted (14 cards), tracking page enable-push-btn in all 3 permission branches (default/denied/granted), and the sanity flow (login, cart persists on refresh, place order -> /orders/{id}?new=1, admin accept -> ACCEPTED).

critical.issue: Returns ALL active coupons including personal referral coupons (WELCOME*/FRIEND*) of every user. They are shown to everyone (even anonymous) under 'Everyone's offers' on /offers; other users copying them get 400 'This coupon is not available for your account'. Fix: filter e.g. db.coupons.find({'active': True, 'personal': {'$ne': True}}) (server.py:433).

minor.issue: Known-open from iteration 1/2: no brute-force lockout — 6 consecutive bad passwords all return 401, never 429/423 (test_auth.py::test_brute_force_lockout_after_5_fails)

Referrer's FRIEND coupon is advertised as 'free delivery' but is implemented as a flat Rs.25 off the subtotal with min_order 149. Delivery fee is per-restaurant (not always 25) and is still charged, so the reward does not actually match the copy shown in ReferralCard/description.

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() is called without .catch(); when the browser blocks clipboard write it produces an uncaught promise rejection (CRA red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay reproduced on /profile) while a false 'Code copied' success toast is still shown. Wrap in try/catch + fallback and only toast on success.

No loading state: 'No orders yet' empty state flashes on every mount/reload before the first /restaurant/orders response; load() also swallows all errors with an empty catch{}, so an API failure is indistinguishable from an empty list.
When several new pending orders arrive in the same 5s poll, only fresh[0] triggers the chime/notification/toast; the other new orders are silently added.

issues: The decorative Gift icon renders partially outside the rounded card (white icon fragments visible below the bottom-right corner) despite overflow-hidden on the wrapper
'Everyone's offers' grid shows other users' WELCOME*/FRIEND* personal codes (backend leak above) — confusing and unusable for the viewer

action_items: Filter personal coupons out of GET /api/offers (server.py:433) — HIGH
Add try/catch (and non-secure-context fallback) around navigator.clipboard.writeText in ReferralCard.jsx and Offers.jsx; only show the success toast when the write resolves
Add a loading state to ROrders and surface load() errors instead of empty catch{}
Decide FRIEND coupon semantics: either make it a real free-delivery coupon (zero delivery_fee) or change the copy from 'free delivery' to 'Rs.25 off'
Brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login still not implemented (carried over from iteration 1/2)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 938 lines — split into routers (auth, catalog, orders, admin, referral) per the <700 line guideline
/api/offers returns raw coupon docs incl. user_id/used_count for personal coupons — response should be a trimmed public model
validate_coupon ownership + used_count checks look correct; place_order correctly deactivates personal coupons after use (verified end-to-end)
ROrders.load()/OrderTracking.load() both use bare `catch {}` — silent failure hides backend errors from users and testers

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 requested UI checks passed; 3 non-blocking defects noted

Checkout requires filling input[placeholder='House / Street'] before Place Order.
rca_of_the_issue: GET /api/offers queries db.coupons with only {'active': True}; personal referral coupons are inserted into the same collection with personal=true + user_id, so they match the public query. Ownership is still enforced at validation time (no financial exploit) but every user's WELCOME/FRIEND codes are publicly enumerable via the API and rendered on /offers.
